recent_posts.text: I finally fired myself from managing my inbox. This is what building with AI actually looks like. Last week, I used Claude Code to ship a Personal Assistant AI. I gave it the keys to the castle: My Inbox, My Calendar, My Slack. It doesn't just summarize. It knows my team, my tone, and my priorities.

Big Tech is spending over $400B on AI infrastructure this year alone. Is this the biggest opportunity of our lifetime, or a bubble destined to pop? Annual AI-related data center spending is ~$400B, yet total AI software revenue is only estimated at ~$60B for 2025. That's quite a disconnect.

The odds: 85+ applicants. 6 finalists. And we're one of them. This Saturday, the Patterno team is heading to the HARBOUR FOUNDER SUMMIT in Hamburg. We're incredibly proud to be selected as one of the six startups pitching live on stage for the Startup World Cup.

Gemini 3 is here, and honestly? The benchmarks are pretty insane. The Interface: Gemini takes this one without a doubt. The UI is slick, responsive, and feels like a significant step up in usability. The Code Execution: Claude retains a better 'intuition' for planning.

The Most In-Demand AI Skill of 2025 Isn't What You Think! The real game-changer? It's 'Context Engineering,' and surprisingly, almost no one is talking about its immense power for building truly reliable AI agents. Companies are desperate for this expertise. We're now seeing dedicated 'Context Engineer' roles popping up, with salaries climbing up to $240k.

company_focus: Patterno automates tender processes using AI, addressing the massive €2T inefficiency in public procurement.
